column1: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Art Director based in Germany.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role shaping the complete visual identity of a multiplayer PvPvE shooter built in Unreal Engine.You’ll own the artistic direction across characters, environments, animation, weapons, concept art, and UI/UX.Working closely with creative, design, product, and technical teams, you’ll ensure every visual element feels cohesive and supports the player experience.You’ll lead a multidisciplinary art team while remaining deeply involved in production and asset development.The role combines high-level artistic vision with practical pipeline, workflow, and production ownership.As the game moves toward Early Access and live content, you’ll help establish scalable processes for new arenas, seasonal content, cosmetics, and ongoing updates.You’ll join a distributed, self-managing team that values open collaboration, strong communication, and ambitious game development.
Own and define the overall art direction, visual identity, and creative standards across the game.
Direct the development of environment art, character and species design, animation, modeling, rigging, texturing, shader development, concept art, 2D assets, and UI/UX.
Establish clear artistic direction and provide regular feedback to ensure assets remain consistent, polished, and aligned with the game's identity.
Maintain a cohesive visual language across playable species, characters, environments, skins, cosmetics, and future content.
Partner closely with creative leadership, game designers, technical leaders, and product stakeholders to integrate art seamlessly with gameplay and game design.
Build and maintain effective 3D art pipelines within Unreal Engine and collaborate with technical teams to resolve production challenges.
Optimize artistic workflows and production processes to balance visual quality, development efficiency, and the pace required for live-service content.
Plan, initiate, execute, and control art production from early concepts through release-ready assets and post-launch updates.
Track milestones, production progress, and deliverables using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Provide regular feedback, guidance, and support to the art team while keeping production aligned with schedules and quality expectations.
Contribute to the development of new arenas, seasonal content, cosmetics, and other post-launch experiences.
Work cross-functionally to identify and resolve technical or production challenges that could affect artistic quality or delivery.
Help establish an environment where different art disciplines collaborate effectively within an agile and distributed production model.
Bachelor's degree in Art, Design, or a closely related discipline, complemented by substantial professional experience in game production.
At least 7 years of professional experience in the gaming industry, with exposure to the full development lifecycle from pre-production through live operations.
Proven experience directing or significantly contributing to at least one shipped AA or AAA game and the ability to support large-scale productions through release.
Hands-on experience creating stylized games with hand-painted textures and maintaining a distinctive, cohesive visual identity across characters and environments.
Strong portfolio demonstrating versatility across traditional art, 3D art, animation, UI/UX, and concept art, with consistently high standards of craftsmanship.
Strong knowledge of multidisciplinary art production, including 2D, 3D, animation, modeling, rigging, texturing, shaders, and UI/UX.
Professional proficiency in Maya and Substance Painter.
Strong experience with Unreal Engine and 3D art production pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to solve technical and production challenges collaboratively with engineering, design, and other cross-functional teams.
Proven ability to improve production workflows and increase both creative output and operational efficiency.
Strong project management and organizational skills, including experience tracking milestones and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.

column1: Join us as an Anti-Financial Crime Working Student or Intern to improve the operational processes behind Qonto’s German branch. Connect teams across Qonto: Coordinate with AFC, AML, Fraud, Banking Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders to gather information, clarify responsibilities, and maintain visibility on open actions.

Broad exposure across Qonto: You’ll work beyond a single team and gain insight into AFC, operations, legal, product, growth, and marketing within Germany—Qonto’s second-largest branch.

Real ownership: This is project-based work rather than a list of repetitive daily tasks. You’ll be expected to investigate problems, propose practical solutions, and turn them into sustainable processes.
Progressive scope: You’ll begin with the physical-mail workflow. As you establish a reliable process, you’ll take on additional coordination projects across AFC and Product.
Hybrid work in Berlin: Approximately 3 days per week in the office to support learning and collaboration.

You are organized and rigorous: You can track several stakeholders, owners, deadlines, and dependencies while understanding why small gaps matter when legal or regulatory requests are involved.

marketing-manager-berlin-407978,MAOMAO Technologies,Marketing Manager (m/f/d),Berlin,False,1790112625,"MAOMAO is a fast-growing online supermarket for Asian food, combining e-commerce with content, community and social commerce.
We don't just sell products. We introduce people to new foods, brands, trends and cultures through TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, TikTok Shop, our online shop and our own products.
As MAOMAO continues to grow, we're looking for a Marketing Manager (m/f/d) who wants to take real ownership and help shape the next stage of our marketing.
You will plan and coordinate marketing campaigns, promotions, product launches and livestreams from idea to execution.
coordinating content and communication across our channels
making sure everyone involved knows what needs to happen and when
keeping projects moving and following up on deliverables
reviewing results and turning learnings into better future campaigns
We are looking for someone who thinks beyond individual tasks and takes responsibility for making the overall project work.
Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue developing.
coordination with TikTok and external partners
identifying and testing new opportunities in social commerce
Experience with TikTok Shop is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter just as much.
You will work with our team to develop campaigns and content around Asian food, products, trends and culture.
which products and topics we should focus on
how we communicate them to our audience
which content formats and channels make sense
how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, our online shop, email and other channels
We want someone who doesn't just create marketing, but increasingly understands why something works and how we can make it better.
Good ideas only matter if they get executed.
You will help coordinate marketing projects across the team, keep track of priorities and deadlines and make sure projects move forward.
Depending on your experience, you may also:
coordinate responsibilities within the marketing team
support and guide other team members
take responsibility for larger marketing initiatives
help shape marketing priorities together with the founders
There is room to take on more leadership responsibility as both you and MAOMAO grow.
Your Role Can Grow With You
We don't expect one person to be an expert in every area of marketing.
Depending on your experience, strengths and interests, you can gradually take on additional responsibility in areas such as:
Analyzing campaign performance, defining measurable goals and using data to improve marketing decisions.
Managing defined budgets and deciding how resources should be allocated across campaigns and channels.
Developing how we communicate with existing customers and improve retention.
Ownership is one of the most important parts of how we work.
It doesn't mean working endless hours or having all the answers.
It means thinking beyond the individual task.
If we are launching a new product in four weeks, we don't want someone who simply waits for a list of things to do.

What are we trying to achieve? What needs to happen? Which channels should we use? What content do we need? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What are we missing? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked?
Just as importantly, we value people who think in solutions, not only in problems.
Pointing out that something is not working is useful. But we expect you to go one step further:
What can we do about it? What are the options? What can we test now? What is the fastest reasonable next step?
You should be willing to make informed decisions, experiment, learn from results and iterate quickly rather than waiting for a perfect answer.
Not every idea will work. That is okay.
What matters is that we learn fast, adjust fast and keep moving.
The mindset we're looking for is:
“Here is the problem. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next.”

We're open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience, but we're looking for someone who has already gained meaningful hands-on marketing experience and is ready to take ownership.

Build channel-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market.&lt
Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged-in routing for non-consenting users.&lt

column1: werkstudent-ev-sales-deal-operations-munchen-138698,Aampere,Werkstudent EV Sales & Deal Operations (m/w/d),München,False,1790107761,"Über AampereWerde Teil von Aampere, einem Seed-Stage VC-backed Startup, das den europäischen Markt für gebrauchte E-Autos neu definiert. Wir ermöglichen es EV-Besitzer:innen, ihr Fahrzeug innerhalb von 48 Stunden zu verkaufen, und verschaffen Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundensegmenten. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, intransparent und schwer vertrauenswürdig, deshalb bauen wir die Infrastruktur, die das ändert, damit mehr Elektroautos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Wandel zur Elektromobilität wirklich an Fahrt aufnimmt.Und es funktioniert: Wir steigern unseren Umsatz Jahr für Jahr um das Vierfache und halten bereits mehr als 1 % des deutschen Consumer-EV-Wiederverkaufsmarkts. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams.Deine MissionDu hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform.Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft.Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten.Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen.Das bringst du mitDein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse.Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl.Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten.Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten.Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr.Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift.Why Aampere?Wachstum &amp
column2: Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle.Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy teamLate Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats)Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next?Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad.Chance auf Übernahme: Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte.Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn......du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind....du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten....du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren....du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen.Wie wir arbeitenDrei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen:Aaudacity. column1: account-executive-full-cycle-new-business-berlin-195633,Mute Labs Gmbh,"Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)",Berlin,False,1790086173,"THE JOBReading this to the end is worth it.The Company: Why mute-labs?mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the ChannelThis is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.Is This You?The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected

Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. This is the most open-ended part of the work and grows over time.Set the research direction by deciding which model capabilities and benchmarks are worth pursuing, choosing what is worth solving rather than optimizing a score someone else set.Bring in external research and real customer needs to shape new model and tooling directions, and publish frontier results that move the field forward.Build trustworthy benchmarks from the structured data behind real, high-impact problems, so the team optimizes for real-world performance rather than one leaderboard.Faithfully implement the baselines and competitor models that set the gold standard of applied data science, giving the team a read on where TabPFN leads and where there is room to improve.Build an automated, agentic pipeline with a human in the loop so this data and benchmark foundation scales to far larger volumes without losing rigor, itself a genuinely new tool.What we're looking forYou have solved data-science problems across many domains and datasets to a high standard, optimizing for strong performance across a whole suite of tasks rather than the single best score on one.You work undogmatically across the ML toolbox, including getting strong results with gradient-boosted trees (such as XGBoost) and not only with deep learning.You understand the common categories of dataset defects (leakage, label noise, distribution shift, duplication, mislabeled targets, and similar) and why each corrupts a training or benchmark signal.You are energized by foundational work, valuing the dataset and benchmark bedrock as much as the frontier tooling, and you have taken on hard problems others passed over.You thrive as a senior individual contributor in an ambiguous, early-stage, low-process environment. column1: senior-finance-manager-berlin-260296,Lemon Markets,Senior Finance Manager (f/m/x),Germany  (Hybrid),False,1789818005,"About lemon.markets 🍋We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.Your MissionYour mission is to be an integral part of building and scaling the Finance function within lemon.markets. As Senior Finance Manager you develop processes and policies as well as support the Product Development team and other functions - becoming the go-to person for external stakeholders and auditors. You will play an important role in establishing lemon.markets as the go-to-provider for launching investment products in Europe.At lemon.markets we value ownership a lot. Meaning you have a lot of autonomy in shaping your area of responsibility. Your report directly to our VP of Finance and collaborating closely with Risk Management, Product, Compliance, among others, making sure our Finance function is set up for long-term operational excellence and scalability. This is your opportunity to have an impact, not just on the Finance department, but also on the product, to help launch a compliant investment product. You will:Manage and optimize various Finance processes, especially within Accounting, but also Regulatory Reporting or Planning and Controlling, by leveraging your knowledge and expertise.Collaborate closely with the VP of Finance on special and strategic projects, helping transition processes into scalable, best-in-class workflows.Be a point of contact for our external auditors, ensuring timely delivery of high quality documentation by various teams.Work together closely with the Management Team and build, monitor  and refine our annual financial plan and timelines.Support on product work, defining and documenting functional requirements, establishing test concepts and testing/documentation and associated implications.Cultivate a culture of knowledge-sharing as you work closely with our Product Development team, bridging the gap between finance and innovation for strategic product advancements.  You will be successful in this role if: You have a strong background in Finance and regulated financial services. You have at least five years of experience in a finance function at a bank, FinTech, or another regulated institution, or with a Big Four or other leading audit firm. You have strong knowledge of German GAAP under HGB, including RechKredV or RechVersV. Knowledge of IFRS is a plus, as is experience with group accounting and consolidation.You are proficient in Excel. You are comfortable using Excel to analyse financial information, prepare reports, and support finance processes. Experience with financial modelling is a plus.You understand regulated financial environments. Experience in the regulated finance industry is required, and exposure to regulatory frameworks such as IFR or CRR would be particularly valuable.You are willing to support in shaping the function. You are a hands-on player, willing to put high-quality processes in place from the beginning while remaining pragmatic with more complex solutions.You thrive on ownership.
